text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, since transferring from Funabashi 
Training Center, I feel it day and 
night...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this Central Tracen Academy just way 
too blessed? Far too much so...

The stark difference is made painfully 
clear... As expected, the quality of the 
facilities here far surpasses Funabashi 
Training Center.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fully equipped with all kinds of courses. 
There's even a woodchip course.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The dedicated staff will handle 
maintenance and odd jobs anyway.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Lunchtime is... all-you-can-eat.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
She even sets up our expedition schedules 
for us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall guide you anywhere. Even to the 
depths of hell. —Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, we'll even be passing right by a 
Hachimi Drink shop."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Um... normal, normal, and normal, please.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Convenience is a good thing. But if we 
keep going like this, won't we grow 
complacent?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If we ever lose our hunger, we won't truly 
be ourselves anymore.

How to put it... It feels like floating in 
a luxurious bath of lukewarm water...

I felt a creeping dread that my fangs were 
gradually being dulled.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Furioso-san, hello! Hey, hey, about 
our post-training treat...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Won't you come see my concert? I got 
special permission to use the outdoor 
stage at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san... To think I'd be able to 
watch a live show right here on campus...

This Umamusume is Smart Falcon. She works 
as an Umamusume idol—an "Umadol."

"She's also quite skilled on dirt tracks, 
and though she has yet to make her debut, 
great things are expected of her future."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you both have troubled looks on 
your faces. Is something bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you're okay with me, want to talk about 
it? Welcome to Umadol Falco's Advice 
Corner!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It's not really big enough to call 
a worry... Besides, I don't want to rely 
on the Central version of Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if I explained it, I doubt 
anyone would understand.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't say that! Since we're 
already here, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... when you're being this kind to 
me...

In the end, pressured by Smart Falcon, 
Furioso confessed her sense of crisis 
regarding their privileged environment.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think I understand that feeling a 
bit. To put it into an analogy...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You start out putting together indie shows 
by hand, but once you make it big, 
everything gets done for you. That kind of 
feeling, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're probably right on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I think having well-equipped facilities is 
wonderful in itself. However—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if there might actually be a 
downside to it. I'm scared it might lead 
to complacency or coddling..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Furioso-san is really serious and 
diligent, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I understand why you'd feel that way, but 
personally, I don't really find it all 
that scary."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It might be faster to show you than to 
explain. How everyone spends their time 
here, that is.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come with me for a second!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

I wonder what she wants to show me. I 
decided to follow Smart Falcon.

We arrived at the training grounds. And 
there, standing before us, was—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The hell? Furioso, Falco... what're you 
two here for?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Espo-san, are you heading to training now?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Can't you tell just by looking? I'm about 
to go run like an absolute madwoman."

This Umamusume is Espoir City. A 
rebellious gyaru who hasn't debuted yet, 
but shares a natural aptitude for dirt 
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Not even a blade of grass is gonna be left 
standing in my wake. Hey, maintenance 
guys, get ready, 'cause I'm gonna tear 
this turf to shreds.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Guy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Espo-chan. Go right ahead, don't hold 
back.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaah!

That run... was astonishing. She literally 
kicked the dirt aside as she surged 
forward—

In no time at all, the track was 
completely churned up. And during a brief 
break...

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Guy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Let's do this, hurry it 
up.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Crew
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

The maintenance crew uses harrows to 
smooth out the dirt and groom the track.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah, it's so shiny and clean!

The track was restored in an instant. 
During the break, it returned to its 
pristine condition once again.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is it, this is what being blessed 
looks like. Usually, they'd never do 
maintenance for you this quickly.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If I stay in an environment like this, 
I'll go soft...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, really? I don't really think that's 
the case, though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get right into it, one more 
rep! I ain't stoppin'. Time to run full 
blast!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Maintenance old man, I'm gonna keep 
working you to the bone, you hear!

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Guy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, go wild as much as you want. I'll 
patch you right back up."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaah!

Espoir City just kept running with all her 
might. Undaunted, pure, and determined.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Espo-san...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Got in plenty of running 
today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Furioso. If you ever feel like it, 
I'm down to take you on anytime!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
See? Just because the environment is great 
doesn't mean we're slacking off, right? It 
just means we can train that much more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And hey, my concert isn't just for fun 
either! Come watch it right now."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks for cheering for me 
today♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Once our singing and dancing get you all 
energized, give it your all again 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Run, stan, and run again! Let's be happy 
to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's not just a breath of fresh 
air...
Yeah, it's not just a casual break...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Everyone should enjoy it to the 
fullest... And not just enjoy it, but make 
up for it with that much more...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm turning it into energy for 
tomorrow... Blessed as I am, I'll turn 
everything into my strength..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So this is what's considered "normal" here 
at the Japan Junior Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it seems I was mistaken. I need 
to be greedier! I have to ride this wave!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If you hold back, you'll just get left 
further and further behind. So...!

From the next day onward, Furioso's 
approach to life shifted just a little.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah? A match race? You've got some nerve 
asking me out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Furio & Espo
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!! Uryaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Intensive dance training? Sure, I'd love 
to, but why so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to absorb everything I can. All of 
it, for the sake of my own growth.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Furioso-san, you're so positive. All 
right, match with me. Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Step, step♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, Furioso... Your running's gotten 
pretty brutal, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, your dancing has improved beyond 
recognition!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

It seemed she had finally gotten a bit 
accustomed to life here at the JRA.

When our paces align, we naturally open up 
to each other. The distance between us and 
the URA Umamusume also gradually...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... Let me make this one thing 
clear: I—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It's not as though I was swayed by your 
feelings. Not at all."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let's do this again. Shall we go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

A tacked-on declaration that she wouldn't 
be swayed. Furioso was someone who would 
never forget her hungry spirit.
